name: Word of Critical Healing
body:
School conjuration (healing); Level bard 4, cleric/oracle 4, druid 5, inquisitor 4, shaman 4, witch 5

This spell functions like word of light healing except except that it cures 4d4 points of damage plus 1 per two caster level (maximum +10).
